class.name: JRPGActorState
class.brief_description: One JRPG actor as it is during play: level, EXP, HP/MP/TP, skills, states, buffs and equipment.
class.description: Created from an actor of the [JRPGDatabase] with [method setup], usually through [method JRPGGameState.ensure_actor]. Parameters come from a [JRPGStatBlock] fed with the class curve at the current level, the parameter bonuses and equipment, the traits of the actor, its class, its equipment and its states, and the buffs. Equipment the actor can no longer use (after a class change, a sealing state, losing dual wield) returns to the inventory of the [JRPGGameState] that owns the actor. HP 0 knocks the actor out: state 1 is added and every other state and buff is removed. Removing state 1, or setting HP above 0, revives the actor. [method serialize] and [method deserialize] save and load the actor in a canonical form; the database is not saved, so call [method set_database] after loading. Online, zone servers own actor states; clients receive copies for menus and battle views.

method.name: add_buff
method.description: Raises [param param] one buff level, up to the project's limit (2 by default); a debuff on it is canceled one level instead. While the level is not 0, its turns become the longer of the current ones and [param turns]. Returns [code]false[/code] for a knocked-out actor.

method.name: add_debuff
method.description: Lowers [param param] one buff level, down to the project's limit; a buff on it is canceled one level instead. Turns work as in [method add_buff]. Returns [code]false[/code] for a knocked-out actor.

method.name: add_param_bonus
method.description: Adds [param amount] to the permanent bonus of a parameter (from events and growth items), kept within ±[constant MAX_PARAM_BONUS].

method.name: add_state
method.description: Adds a state, or refreshes its turns when the actor already has it. Turns are drawn from [param random] between the state's minimum and maximum turns (the maximum when [param random] is [code]null[/code]); states without auto-removal have none. Unknown states, states the actor resists and states on a knocked-out actor are refused ([code]false[/code]). State 1 knocks the actor out.

method.name: can_equip
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when the actor may use the weapon or armor: an Equip Weapon or Equip Armor trait allows its type, and its slot type is not sealed.

method.name: change_class
method.description: Moves the actor to class [param class_id]. With [param keep_level] the level stays and the EXP becomes what the new class needs for it; otherwise the EXP stays and the level follows the new class's EXP table. Equipment the new class cannot use returns to the party's inventory. Returns [code]false[/code] when the class does not exist.

method.name: change_equip
method.description: Equips the weapon or armor [param id] in [param slot], or takes the slot's item off when [param id] is 0. The party must own the item: it leaves the inventory and the previous item returns to it. Locked and sealed slots, items for another slot and items the actor cannot use are refused ([code]false[/code]).

method.name: change_exp
method.description: Sets the EXP total, then levels up or down to match it, within 1 and [method get_max_level]. Class skills of every level reached are learned. Returns a [Dictionary] with [code]old_level[/code], [code]level[/code] and [code]learned_skills[/code] for level-up messages. Level-ups do not heal.

method.name: change_level
method.description: Sets the level, within 1 and [method get_max_level], and the EXP total that level needs. Returns the same report as [method change_exp].

method.name: clear_buffs
method.description: Removes every buff and debuff.

method.name: clear_equipment
method.description: Takes off everything in unlocked slots, back to the party's inventory.

method.name: clear_name_override
method.description: Uses the database name again.

method.name: clear_nickname_override
method.description: Uses the database nickname again.

method.name: deserialize
method.description: Replaces the actor with [param data], made by [method serialize]. Malformed data leaves the actor unchanged and returns [constant ERR_INVALID_DATA].

method.name: force_equip
method.description: Equips without ownership or lock checks and without returning the previous item, as for initial equipment. Items the actor cannot use, or that do not fit the slot, are discarded. Returns [code]true[/code] when the item ends up equipped.

method.name: forget_skill
method.description: Forgets a learned skill. Returns [code]false[/code] when it was not learned.

method.name: gain_exp
method.description: Adds [param amount] EXP (negative to remove) and levels up or down like [method change_exp].

method.name: gain_hp
method.description: Changes HP by [param amount] like [method set_hp].

method.name: gain_mp
method.description: Changes MP by [param amount], within 0 and max MP.

method.name: gain_tp
method.description: Changes TP by [param amount], within 0 and the project's maximum TP.

method.name: get_actor_id
method.description: Returns the ID of the actor in the database.

method.name: get_actor_name
method.description: Returns the name set by an event, or the database name.

method.name: get_buff_level
method.description: Returns the buff level of a parameter: positive for buffs, negative for debuffs.

method.name: get_buff_turns
method.description: Returns the turns left for the buff or debuff of a parameter.

method.name: get_class_id
method.description: Returns the ID of the actor's class.

method.name: get_database
method.description: Returns the database the actor reads its data from.

method.name: get_equip
method.description: Returns the ID of the weapon or armor in [param slot], or 0 when it is empty.

method.name: get_equip_kind
method.description: Returns whether [param slot] holds a weapon, an armor or nothing.

method.name: get_equip_slot_count
method.description: Returns how many equipment slots the actor has (one per equipment type of the database).

method.name: get_equip_slot_types
method.description: Returns the equipment type of each slot: slot N takes type N, except that dual wield (Slot Type trait) makes the second slot a weapon slot.

method.name: get_exp
method.description: Returns the EXP total.

method.name: get_exp_for_level
method.description: Returns the EXP total needed to reach [param level] in the actor's class.

method.name: get_exp_to_next_level
method.description: Returns the EXP still needed for the next level, or 0 at the maximum level.

method.name: get_hp
method.description: Returns the current HP.

method.name: get_learned_skills
method.description: Returns the learned skill IDs in ascending order.

method.name: get_level
method.description: Returns the current level.

method.name: get_max_hp
method.description: Returns the maximum HP.

method.name: get_max_level
method.description: Returns the highest level the actor can reach (its database maximum level).

method.name: get_max_mp
method.description: Returns the maximum MP.

method.name: get_mp
method.description: Returns the current MP.

method.name: get_nickname
method.description: Returns the nickname set by an event, or the database nickname.

method.name: get_param
method.description: Returns a parameter after equipment, traits and buffs ([enum JRPGClassData.Param] order).

method.name: get_param_bonus
method.description: Returns the permanent bonus of a parameter.

method.name: get_skills
method.description: Returns the learned skills plus the skills added by traits, in ascending order.

method.name: get_sparam
method.description: Returns an sp-parameter in basis points (10000 = 100%).

method.name: get_state_steps
method.description: Returns the steps walked while affected by a state.

method.name: get_state_turns
method.description: Returns the turns left before a state's auto-removal.

method.name: get_states
method.description: Returns the IDs of the actor's states in ascending order.

method.name: get_stats
method.description: Returns the [JRPGStatBlock] that computes the actor's parameters.

method.name: get_tp
method.description: Returns the current TP.

method.name: get_xparam
method.description: Returns an ex-parameter in basis points (10000 = 100%).

method.name: has_learned_skill
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when the actor has learned the skill.

method.name: has_name_override
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when an event set the actor's name.

method.name: has_nickname_override
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when an event set the actor's nickname.

method.name: has_state
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when the actor has the state.

method.name: is_dead
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when the actor is knocked out (has state 1).

method.name: is_equip_slot_locked
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when a Lock Equip trait prevents changing [param slot].

method.name: is_equip_slot_sealed
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when a Seal Equip trait prevents equipping anything in [param slot].

method.name: learn_skill
method.description: Learns a skill. Returns [code]false[/code] when it was already learned.

method.name: recover_all
method.description: Restores HP and MP to their maximums and removes every state, including the knockout.

method.name: remove_buff
method.description: Removes a buff. Does nothing on a debuffed parameter ([code]false[/code]).

method.name: remove_debuff
method.description: Removes a debuff. Does nothing on a buffed parameter ([code]false[/code]).

method.name: remove_state
method.description: Removes a state. Removing state 1 revives the actor with 1 HP. Returns [code]false[/code] when the actor did not have it.

method.name: repair_references
method.description: Attaches [param database] and fixes references to entries deleted since the actor was saved, before anything is computed: a deleted class becomes class 1; deleted skills, states and equipment are dropped; the level is kept within the maximum level. Returns how many references were fixed. [method JRPGGameState.attach_database] calls it for every actor.

method.name: serialize
method.description: Returns the actor as a [Dictionary] of plain values in a canonical form. Names are included only when an event set them.

method.name: set_buff_turns
method.description: Sets the turns left for the buff or debuff of a parameter (ignored when its level is 0).

method.name: set_database
method.description: Attaches the database after loading; parameters, HP, MP and TP limits are recomputed from it.

method.name: set_hp
method.description: Sets HP within 0 and max HP. HP 0 knocks the actor out; HP above 0 revives a knocked-out actor.

method.name: set_mp
method.description: Sets MP within 0 and max MP.

method.name: set_name_override
method.description: Sets the actor's name for the rest of the game (Change Name).

method.name: set_nickname_override
method.description: Sets the actor's nickname for the rest of the game.

method.name: set_state_steps
method.description: Sets the steps walked while affected by a state the actor has.

method.name: set_state_turns
method.description: Sets the turns left for a state the actor has.

method.name: set_tp
method.description: Sets TP within 0 and the project's maximum TP.

method.name: setup
method.description: Starts the actor from the database: its class, initial level and that level's EXP, the class skills learned up to that level, full HP and MP, no TP. Returns [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST] when [param database] has no actor [param actor_id].

constants.constant: Largest permanent parameter bonus, positive or negative.
Number of equipment slots when the database has no type lists.
